children: , which recently launched its initial public offering in March, has inked a deal with Nebius
to provide 50 MW of critical IT capacity at AIB's facility located in the southeastern U.S.

The contracted capacity is supported by AIB's previously announced 15-year Electric Service Agreement for 65MW of utility load at the site, which requires no significant additional electrical infrastructure upgrades. AIB expects to deliver the capacity in two data halls.

"Signing Nebius represents a transformational milestone for AIB," said AIB CEO Jerry Tang. "Our strategy is straightforward: secure power in attractive markets and convert that power into long-term contracted revenue with leading AI infrastructure companies. This agreement validates that strategy."

"Time-to-power is the binding constraint on AI infrastructure today, and AIB's existing power position gave us a clear path to bringing this capacity online on a timeline that works for our customers," said Andrey Korolenko, chief product and infrastructure officer at Nebius. "This agreement adds dedicated capacity in the southeastern United States for training and inference workloads."
AIB also recently completed an acquisition in Texas to increase its total contracted power to 120MW.

title: AIB lands deal with Nebius to provide 50MW of capacity in Southeast US
